'''Comet Busters''' was a company that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Comet Busters was owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nad Baron]] and specialized in destroying rogue [[Comet/Legends|comets]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. As a rival firm, the [[Comet Broom Service]], got most of the best comet contracts, Comet Busters often took less lucrative jobs that were sub-contracted out to them by Comet Broom.

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the owners of Comet Broom supplied a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] with some astrometric data, while on [[Artom Station]]. Some Comet Busters employees learned of this, so they attacked the agents on the station, in an attempt to obtain the data.
